import logging
import re
import sys

import brimloom
from brimloom.asserts import verify

log = logging.getLogger("site_tests")
BASE_URL = "https://docs.example-site.test/"


def test_has_title(view):
    # Abrir la vista y verificar que el título contenga el texto buscado
    view.open(BASE_URL)
    verify(view).title_matches(re.compile("Portal"))


def test_follow_start_button(view):
    # Tocar el botón "Comenzar" y esperar la sección de instalación
    view.open(BASE_URL)
    view.locate(role="button", label="Comenzar").tap()
    verify(view.locate(role="section", label="Instalación")).is_shown()


def run_suite(view):
    results = {}

            results[case.__name__] = "ok"
        except brimloom.AssertionFailure as exc:
            log.error("%s falló: %s", case.__name__, exc)
            results[case.__name__] = "fail"
    return results


def main(argv):

    with brimloom.launch() as runner:
        view = runner.open_view()
        results = run_suite(view)
        view.close()
    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
    return 0 if all(v == "ok" for v in results.values()) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":

import csv
import io
import logging
import urllib.request

from ohlcforge import CandleFigure

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
DATA_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/example/datasets/main/finance-charts-sample.csv"


def download_rows(url):
    logger.info("Descargando datos desde %s", url)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as response:
        text = response.read().decode("utf-8")
    return list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text)))


def build_series(rows, prefix="AAPL"):
    return {
        "dates": [row["Date"] for row in rows],
        "open": [float(row[f"{prefix}.Open"]) for row in rows],
        "high": [float(row[f"{prefix}.High"]) for row in rows],
        "low": [float(row[f"{prefix}.Low"]) for row in rows],
        "close": [float(row[f"{prefix}.Close"]) for row in rows],
    }


def draw(series):
    fig = CandleFigure()
    fig.add_candles(
        x=series["dates"],
        open=series["open"],
        high=series["high"],
        low=series["low"],
        close=series["close"],
    )
    # El control deslizante del rango se oculta para que el gráfico sea compacto
    fig.set_layout(range_slider_visible=False)
    return fig


def main():
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    rows = download_rows(DATA_URL)
    series = build_series(rows)
    logger.info("Velas cargadas: %d", len(series["dates"]))
    draw(series).show()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    return {
        "dates": [row["Date"] for row in rows],

        "high": [float(row[f"{prefix}.High"]) for row in rows],
        "low": [float(row[f"{prefix}.Low"]) for row in rows],
        "close": [float(row[f"{prefix}.Close"]) for row in rows],
    }

def draw(series):
    fig = go.Figure(data=[go.Candlestick(
        x=series["dates"],
        open=series["open"],
        high=series["high"],
        low=series["low"],
        close=series["close"],
    )])
    # El control deslizante del rango se oculta para que el gráfico sea compacto
    fig.update_layout(xaxis_rangeslider_visible=False)
    return fig

    rows = download_rows(DATA_URL)
    series = build_series(rows)
    logger.info("Velas cargadas: %d", len(series["dates"]))
    draw(series).show()

import argparse
import logging
import sys

import altair as alt

logger = logging.getLogger("tips_chart")

def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Meal cost against gratuity")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default=None, help="Optional HTML output file")
    parser.add_argument("--marker", type=int, default=8)
    return parser

def draw_chart(table, marker):
    # Points colored by weekday, with descriptive axis titles
    return alt.Chart(table).mark_point(size=marker).encode(
        x="meal_cost",
        y="gratuity",
        color="weekday",
    )

def main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    table = alt.Data(url="https://vega.github.io/vega-datasets/data/restaurants.json")
    chart = draw_chart(table, args.marker)
    try:
        if args.output:
            chart.save(args.output)
            logger.info("Chart saved to %s", args.output)
        else:
            chart.display()
    except OSError as exc:
        logger.error("Could not write chart: %s", exc)
        return 1
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
